item.title: Competitive Integrity Update: Modified PlayStation 4 Consoles
item.description: We have confirmed the use of modified PlayStation 4 consoles to gain an unfair advantage in Apex Legends. Our Anti-Cheat team has implemented dedicated detection measures to identify players using these modifications and we have been in contact with Sony. Players identified using modified hardware to cheat will receive hardware bans on their consoles.
